name: writing-skills
description: 'Use when writing, updating, or reviewing skills in this repository to keep instructions concise and supporting references easy to discover and scan.'
---

# Writing skills

- Keep each `SKILL.md` approximately 500 lines or less. Keep the core workflow
  and critical instructions in the skill; move additional information into a
  `references/` folder beside `SKILL.md`.
- When a skill has references, include a table in `SKILL.md` linking to each
  reference with a brief description of when to load it. Load only the references
  needed for the current task.
- Put critical information at the top of each reference, immediately after its
  title, followed by a linked table of contents for quick scanning.
- When moving instructions into references, preserve the skill's behavior and
  safeguards. Verify relative links, table-of-contents anchors, and line counts.
